title: mdm.org_position.changed.v1
description: A position's complete current state; the record ID is its UUIDv7. A position belongs to one unit and never moves: a position in another unit is a new position. Appointments hang on the legal entity, the unit and the position (mdm/employee): a retired position ends them there. Also the data of SourceService for AGGREGATE_POSITION.

unit_id.description: the unit the position belongs to
